_note: League vote archive. Sources are WhatsApp poll screenshots and Google Forms exports in the league Drive folder. 'winner' is the option with the most votes; in WhatsApp screenshots the green check marks the screenshotter's own vote, not the outcome.

highlights: League fee $125
Champion $1,200 / Runner-up $200 / Season scoring champion $100
No weekly high-score prize
League fee raised to $150
Season scoring champion replaced by a weekly high-score prize: $20 through week 13
Runner-up raised to $340
Trade Vetoes section added (4.4.1)
Offseason Rule Change Voting section added (6.1)
FAAB budget of $100 documented
Weekly high-score prize raised to $25 and extended through week 14
Champion raised to $1,750, runner-up set to $300
Keeper phase-out scheduled: 2 keepers in 2024, 1 in 2025, none from 2026
League fee raised to $200 (from the Aug 2024 vote)
Keepers section retired; only conditional 'Keeper Season' language remains
Section 4 renumbered: Draft, Free Agency, Trades, Rosters, Active Ownership
versions.gaps: Superseded by the version 6 draft, which applies the passed-but-uncodified votes and records the end of keepers.

highlights: Sacko presents at the draft instead of paying $50 toward food (Aug 2026, 7-5)
Penalty exists for failing to set a lineup; the penalty itself is still undecided (Aug 2026, 12-0)
Eliminated teams have rosters locked, elimination determined by ESPN (Aug 2026, 10-2)
Draft order randomized every season; lottery and consolation bracket retired with keepers
Moratorium (The Peter Rule) limited to Keeper Seasons only
Playoff matchups decided on points if a game is cancelled (Aug 2023, 6-3)
Any league matter may be revisited annually; the two-year cycle is gone (Aug 2023, 7-3)

votes.title: Increase the league buy-in for 2026
votes.question: Should we increase the league buy-in for the 2026 season?
votes.outcome: Rejected. Buy-in stays at the $200 set by the 2024 vote.

votes.title: Remove the Kicker position
votes.question: Should we keep the Kicker (K) position in our league?
votes.outcome: Rejected. Kickers stay, which is why the roster table in v5 still lists K.

votes.title: Penalty for an incomplete starting lineup
votes.question: Should there be a league penalty for failing to set a proper/complete starting lineup each week?
votes.outcome: Unanimous. A penalty will exist; the punishment itself was left to a separate decision. Not yet in the constitution.

votes.title: Lock rosters of eliminated teams
votes.question: Should a team's roster be locked from all adds, drops, and trades once that team is mathematically eliminated from playoff contention?

options.label: No — Allow roster moves to continue

votes.outcome: Passed decisively. Eliminated teams have their rosters locked. Not yet written into the constitution.

votes.title: Weekly median win/loss
votes.question: Should teams get an additional W or L each week based on whether they score above or below the league median?

votes.title: Re-seed the playoffs each round
votes.question: Should the playoffs re-seed after each round so the highest remaining seed always plays the lowest remaining seed?

options.label: No — Keep a fixed playoff bracket

votes.outcome: Rejected. The playoff bracket stays fixed.

votes.title: Replace the $50 Sacko food penalty with a PowerPoint
votes.question: Should we replace the current Sacko punishment of contributing $50 toward draft-day food with a PowerPoint presentation explaining why his team was the worst in the league?

options.label: Replace it with the Sacko PowerPoint presentation

votes.outcome: Passed. Last place now presents a PowerPoint on why his team was the worst. Not yet in the constitution.

votes.title: Set the league buy-in
votes.question: What should The League's buy-in be?
votes.outcome: Buy-in set to $200, which is what v5 of the constitution records.

votes.title: Penalty for unpaid league dues
votes.question: What should the penalty be for League members that have not paid their League dues by week 4?

options.label: 5 point deduction for every week they do not pay (starts week 5, continues until they pay)
Increased League due for the following season (+$5 per week added to next year's dues)

votes.outcome: The 5-point weekly deduction is now constitution 2.0.
votes.verified: Vote counts cross-checked against the per-person voter list.

votes.title: Re-randomize the schedule
votes.question: Are you cool with resetting the schedule? Literally just re-randomizing it.

votes.title: Second-place payout
votes.question: Now that buy-in is $200, what should 2nd place get?

votes.title: Vote on league matters every year
votes.question: Should we lift the requirement where league matters can only be voted on every other year, or should we be able to vote on the same things every year?

options.label: No, let's keep it to every other year

votes.outcome: The every-other-year restriction was lifted; anything can be revisited annually.
votes.note: Constitution 1.1 still describes the two-year cycle, so the document lags this vote.

votes.title: Yardage points for DSTs
votes.question: Do we incorporate yardage points for DSTs? Specifically, do we reward DSTs for allowing less yards, likely on a 3,2,1 or 4,3,2,1 format.

votes.title: Keep the offseason moratorium

votes.title: Playoff game cancellation tiebreak
votes.question: In the case of a freaky game cancellation in the playoffs (think Bengals/Bills), what happens to a matchup?

votes.title: Raise league dues to $150

_method: Google Forms pie charts: the percentage labels are positioned by slice geometry, NOT legend order, so text extraction cannot tell you which option won. Every Forms result here was read from the rendered chart (blue = first legend item, red = second). WhatsApp polls print an explicit vote count beside each option, so those are read directly - but the green check marks the screenshotter's own vote, not the winning option.
_openQuestions: The 2018 and 2019 dues votes both required unanimity and both fell short (9-3 and 11-1), yet the fee rose from $125 to $150 in constitution v2. How that happened is not recorded in the archive.
The August 2026 vote created a penalty for failing to set a lineup but explicitly deferred what the penalty is. The league has not decided yet, so no specific penalty is enforceable.
